sentences.text:
Kiran Kumar Ray vs Unknown on 15 July, 2024
Author: Arijit Banerjee

Bench: Arijit Banerjee
15.07.2024 Item no. 25.
Court No.28.
Ab (Rejected) Crm (Db) 2044 of 2024 In Re: An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code
of Criminal Procedure in connection with Khardah P.S. Case No.522 of 2023 dated 18.8.23 under
Sections 376D/498A/ 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 4/6/8/21 of the Pocso
Act And In the matter of : Kiran Kumar Ray @ Kiran Kumar Roy & Anr.
......Petitioners.

entities.text: Kiran Kumar Ray @ Kiran Kumar Roy
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: Mr. Kallol Mondal, Mr. Krishan Ray, Mr. Souvik Das, Mr. Anamitra Banerjee ......for the Petitioners.
Mr. Partha Pratim Das Ms. Debjani Sahu ......for the State.
The petitioners say that they have been falsely implicated.
They are in custody for 302 days.
Charge sheet was filed in November, 2023.
Charge has not been framed as yet.
We have seen the material in the case diary and in particular, the statement of one of the minor victims (11 years old) recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
The same directly and clearly implicates the petitioners.
The alleged offence as narrated by the said victim girl is heinous and culpable to say the least.
In view of the prima facie incriminating material against the petitioner and the gravity of the alleged offence, we are not inclined to entertain the petitioners' prayer for bail.
The prayer for bail is, accordingly, rejected.
CRM (DB) 2044 of 2024 is dismissed.

Signed By :
APURBA BANDYOPADHYAY High Court of Calcutta 15 th of July 2024 05:48:16 PM
We are told that July 16, 2024, has been fixed as the date for consideration of charge.

We direct the learned Trial Court to ensure that charge is considered on that date and if charge is framed, then to conclude the trial as soon as possible, without granting any unnecessary adjournment to either of the parties.
The parties shall communicate this order to the learned Trial Court.
All parties shall act in terms of server copy of the order downloaded from the official website of this Court.
